backdoor-roth-ira.title: Allocate basis across existing IRA balances
backdoor-roth-ira.inputs: case_scope: Ordinary case; basis confirmed; prior_basis: 0; current_nondeductible: 7500; year_end_iras: 92500; outstanding_rollovers: 0; converted: 7500; assumed_rate: 24
steps: Pool = 92,500 year-end values + 7,500 conversion = 100,000.
7,500 / 100,000 = 7.5% nontaxable fraction; conversion basis is 562.50.
Taxable conversion = 7,500 − 562.50 = 6,937.50.
backdoor-roth-ira.answer: Taxable portion of 2026 Roth conversions: 6,937.50 under these assumptions.

backdoor-roth-ira.title: Convert with no other included year-end IRA value

steps: Basis and the conversion pool are both 7,500.

backdoor-roth-ira.answer: Taxable portion of 2026 Roth conversions: 0.00 under these assumptions.

backdoor-roth-ira.title: Keep growth above nondeductible basis taxable

steps: Basis is 7,500 but 7,600 is converted after assumed growth.
The conversion uses 7,500 of basis, leaving 100 taxable.
backdoor-roth-ira.answer: Taxable portion of 2026 Roth conversions: 100.00 under these assumptions.

backdoor-roth-ira.title: Exclude an early-2027 contribution from the 2026 allocation
backdoor-roth-ira.inputs: case_scope: Ordinary case; basis confirmed; prior_basis: 0; current_nondeductible: 7500; year_end_iras: 92500; outstanding_rollovers: 0; converted: 7500; assumed_rate: 24; next_year_contribution: 7500; other_distributions: 0
steps: All 7,500 of the 2026 contribution was made in early 2027.
With no prior basis, eligible 2026 allocation basis is zero; the 7,500 conversion is taxable.
The 7,500 contribution remains in total carryforward basis.
backdoor-roth-ira.answer: Taxable portion of 2026 Roth conversions: 7,500.00 under these assumptions.

backdoor-roth-ira.title: Share basis once across conversion and other included distributions
backdoor-roth-ira.inputs: case_scope: Ordinary case; basis confirmed; prior_basis: 0; current_nondeductible: 7500; year_end_iras: 82500; outstanding_rollovers: 0; converted: 7500; assumed_rate: 24; next_year_contribution: 0; other_distributions: 10000
steps: Pool = 82,500 + 7,500 converted + 10,000 other distributions = 100,000.
Basis used = 562.50 on conversion + 750 on other distributions = 1,312.50.
Carryforward basis = 7,500 − 1,312.50 = 6,187.50.
backdoor-roth-ira.answer: Remaining IRA basis after 2026 allocation: 6,187.50 under these assumptions.

backdoor-roth-ira.title: Include established basis carried from earlier years

steps: Total eligible basis = 2,500 prior + 7,500 current = 10,000.
The 100,000 pool produces a 10% nontaxable fraction, so 9,000 of the conversion is taxable.
backdoor-roth-ira.answer: Taxable portion of 2026 Roth conversions: 9,000.00 under these assumptions.

backdoor-roth-ira.title: Preserve basis when only part of a basis-only pool is converted
backdoor-roth-ira.inputs: case_scope: Ordinary case; basis confirmed; prior_basis: 0; current_nondeductible: 7500; year_end_iras: 3750; outstanding_rollovers: 0; converted: 3750; assumed_rate: 24
